blocks.text: After her three consecutive Best Actress awards for her coming-of-age movie “Sunshine,” Maris Racal is not about to rest on her laurels. These three acting plums are nothing to sneer at, too: Best Actress award at the 49th Gawad Urian; Movie Actress of the Year award at the 42nd PMPC Star Awards; and, Actress of Distinction award at the 74th Famas awards.
